briefdescription.para: call after object has been constructed to build the map w/ labels

detaileddescription.para: Labels are numbered 0..n-1 where n is the number of labels associated with AST nodes (not all nodes are labeled, and some nodes are associated with more than one label). A return value of NO_LABEL means that this node has no label.

Returns the node with the label 'label'. If the return value is 0 then no node exists for this label - this can only be the case if label is erroneously higher than the number of labeled nodes or NO_LABEL.
